question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**controlled**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given passage, the blank 2 will explain how the population of red kite was handled.
 
• **The verb 'controlled' means to manage or regulate something.** (नियंत्रित)
 
 
• Example: The traffic police officer controlled the flow of vehicles on the busy road.</spa
